name: Inner Clip
overview: Inner Clip is a web series that captures the reality behind automotive racing and drifting at the competition level. The series tries to show the inner workings of a team that like many struggles to get enough funding to compete at a high level. It also shows the passion that many drivers have to go out and fulfill their dreams.
